jobs.title: AI Engineer – Graduate (BCG X)
jobs.snippet: Join BCG X as an AI Engineer. Multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, AI engineers, software developers, and product managers deploy production-grade AI solutions side-by-side with consultants and clients. Open to penultimate/final-year undergrad or postgrad students in AI, CS, Data Science, ML, Engineering, Maths, Stats, or Physics.

jobs.title: AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer (BCG X)
jobs.snippet: BCG X Sydney seeks AI Engineers and Senior AI Engineers to build and deploy advanced AI solutions for enterprise clients. Role spans architecture design to production delivery of scalable ML and GenAI systems. Salary range $180k–$200k base + bonus.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Consulting Graduate (BCG X)
jobs.snippet: BCG X Perth graduate AI Engineer position embedded within consulting engagements. Work across the full AI development lifecycle — from problem scoping to deploying production-grade models. For penultimate or final-year students in technical fields.

jobs.title: ML/AI Software Engineer – Electronic Warfare
jobs.snippet: DroneShield (ASX: DRO) seeks an ML/AI Software Engineer to develop and improve machine learning technology in the radio-frequency (RF) and electronic warfare domain. Based at DroneShield's Sydney headquarters in Pyrmont. Team growing to ~500 staff by end of 2026.

jobs.title: Graduate Field Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Deliver high-quality datasets to support the ML lifecycle for DroneShield's proprietary drone detection algorithms. Graduate role based at DroneShield Pyrmont HQ, Sydney. Work within the data engineering team across collection, labelling, and pipeline management for RF/AI systems.

jobs.title: Data, AI, and Machine Learning – Opportunities Available
jobs.snippet: Deloitte Australia Data, AI & ML practice — design, develop and apply analytics, AI, and machine learning models across major industries. Roles span data engineers, cloud engineers, ML engineers, and applied AI specialists. Sydney-based with hybrid working.

jobs.title: Summer Intern Program – Digital, Data and AI
jobs.snippet: NAB 2026–2027 Summer Intern Program in Digital, Data and AI. Commencing November 2026. Gain hands-on exposure to advanced analytics, machine learning techniques, and enterprise AI platforms within Australia's largest business bank.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: 12-month fixed-term Graduate Data Scientist role at NTI Limited, Brisbane, commencing July 2026. Apply academic foundations to real-world data and AI problems in the insurance and transport industry. Work alongside experienced data science and AI leaders across the full DS lifecycle.

jobs.title: Data Scientist – AI Agent Engineering & Infrastructure
jobs.snippet: Binance seeks a Data Scientist to design, build, and deploy production-grade multi-agent AI systems that reason, plan, and execute tasks at scale. The role sits in the AI Agent Engineering & Infrastructure team, available in Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Aera Technology (AI-powered decision intelligence platform) is hiring a Senior Data Scientist in Sydney to drive high-impact ML solutions for enterprise customers. Requires proven hands-on experience with modern ML/AI, MLOps practices, and Generative AI. Solve complex customer problems with advanced Data Science techniques.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: MYOB Melbourne seeks a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead ML architecture, implement MLOps CI/CD pipelines, and drive end-to-end ownership of production ML systems. Principal-level technical leadership with expertise in ML platform engineering and model lifecycle management.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: MYOB Melbourne is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build and support reliable data flows for the data platform, enabling scalable data product development across the business. Work with modern data stack tooling including dbt and cloud data warehouses.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Analytic Partners (Sydney) seeks a Senior Data Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced data science and AI solutions for marketing analytics clients. Role involves applying ML and statistical models to real-world datasets across global brands in Sydney and Melbourne offices.

jobs.title: 大模型算法实习生（AI Platform方向）
jobs.snippet: 字节跳动 AI Platform 团队招募大模型算法实习生，方向涵盖供应链大模型、国际化电商搜索生成式召回排序优化、多语言电商垂域模型建设及应用。要求熟悉深度学习框架（PyTorch/TensorFlow），有大模型相关科研或项目经验优先。

jobs.title: 混元大模型预训练算法实习生
jobs.snippet: 腾讯混元大模型预训练组招募算法实习生，参与混元基座模型预训练、数据工程及模型优化工作。青云计划专项，享受行业顶格薪酬，提供转正通道。要求熟悉大语言模型相关技术，硕士及以上学历优先，工作地点北京。

jobs.title: 大模型推理优化算法实习生（青云计划）
jobs.snippet: 腾讯青云计划招募大模型推理优化算法实习生，方向包括混元大模型压缩算法研究（量化、投机采样、稀疏化）及大规模强化学习框架性能优化。薪酬不设上限，提供住宿餐饮补贴，工作地点深圳，面向2027届及之后毕业生。

jobs.title: AI Agent优化工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 阿里巴巴2027届实习生校招新增七大AI岗位类型之一。负责Agent系统的优化与迭代，包括工具调用、规划能力、多智能体协作等方向，结合大模型能力构建高效的AI Agent应用。工作地点杭州/北京/上海，AI相关岗位占比超80%。

jobs.title: AI数据工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 阿里巴巴2027届实习生新增AI数据工程师岗位，负责AI训练数据的采集、清洗、标注与管道建设，支持大模型训练与评估体系。涵盖阿里云、淘天集团、通义实验室等16个业务板块，工作地点杭州/北京。

jobs.title: AI应用算法工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 阿里巴巴2027届校招新增AI应用算法工程师岗位，负责将大模型能力落地到业务场景，包括RAG、fine-tuning、提示工程及AI应用系统工程化。面向淘天、阿里云、国际等多业务板块，工作地点上海/杭州/北京。

jobs.title: Agent Infra工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 阿里巴巴2027届新增Agent Infra工程师实习岗位，负责构建支撑AI Agent系统运行的底层基础设施，包括工具调用框架、记忆管理、多智能体通信等。要求熟悉Python、分布式系统，有大模型或Agent系统开发经验者优先。工作地点杭州。

jobs.title: 跨模态生成算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 百度2027届史上最大规模暑期实习（5000+岗位，九成与AI相关）新设岗位之一。负责跨模态内容生成算法研究与工程化落地，涵盖图文、音视频多模态生成方向。要求熟悉深度学习，有多模态生成相关研究经验优先。申请截止2026年6月1日。

jobs.title: 智能驾驶算法实习生（Apollo）
jobs.snippet: 百度Apollo自动驾驶团队2027届暑期实习，参与智能驾驶感知、规控、预测等核心算法研发。百度7大业务实习项目之一，提供丰厚实习津贴及转正机会。要求熟悉深度学习或强化学习，有自动驾驶相关项目经验者优先。工作地点北京。

jobs.title: 大语言模型评测产品经理实习生
jobs.snippet: 百度2027届暑期实习新设岗位，负责大语言模型评测体系设计与产品落地，包括benchmark构建、自动化评测管道、模型能力分析报告。要求对大模型有深入理解，具备产品思维和数据分析能力。工作地点北京。

jobs.title: 搜广推算法实习生
jobs.snippet: 京东JD Young实习生计划（月薪万元+），搜广推（搜索、广告、推荐）算法方向，参与京东自营及平台业务的核心推荐排序模型研发。方向涵盖大模型在电商场景的应用、召回精排、用户意图理解。工作地点北京。面向2027届及之后毕业生。

jobs.title: NLP算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 网易云音乐招募NLP算法工程师实习生，依托云音乐大模型落地实践平台，参与歌词理解、评论分析、音乐推荐语料构建及LLM fine-tuning。公司已建立支持跨模态和LLM预训练大模型的ML平台，助力AI能力工程化落地AIGC业务。工作地点杭州。
